ui_bugs.issue: ROOT CAUSE: <DragOverlay> renders as a direct child of the calendar-page div which has Tailwind 'space-y-6' -> overlay wrapper (position:fixed) receives margin-top:24px. Overlay rect measured by dnd-kit is 24px below the real chip/pointer (style top 656px but rendered at 680px). Collision detection (default rectIntersection on overlay rect) therefore selects the cell below the cursor: week view lands 1 hour later whenever the cursor is in the upper ~2/3 of a 36px row; month view jumps to next week when dropping in lower part of a cell. Fix: move DragOverlay out of the space-y container (e.g. wrap DndContext children in a <div>, or render DragOverlay via createPortal(document.body)), or give it className='!mt-0'; additionally consider collisionDetection={pointerWithin} for pointer-accurate drops.
Dialog content overflows horizontally: Copy button, link buttons and reset text are clipped on the right. Input in flex row needs min-w-0 / dialog needs max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]

issues: Month cells show only dots (chips hidden below md), so drag&drop in month view is impossible on phones although the drag hint is shown; only week view supports touch drag
